signals.label: Hidden caps

This policy is designed to prevent excessive or unreasonable usage that may degrade the performance, reliability, or availability of Formly for other users.

trials.claim: Lifetime access to Formly is included
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Formly - Forms, Surveys & Quizzes (Typeform/Jotform alternative)
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms purchasing Formly as a Lifetime Tier 2 deal. The termination clause and AI-form cap do not show that lifetime access was not included.

exhibits.quote: Formly reserves the right to Suspend or terminate customers account.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be suspended or terminated by the vendor for usage reasons.

exhibits.quote: the creators have put a hard limit on how many AI generated forms you get.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime deal imposes a hard cap on AI form creation that is never renewed.

exhibits.quote: I purchased Formly at Tier 2, Lifetime, so I could use it on several sites without the branding
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms purchasing Formly as a Lifetime Tier 2 deal.

trials.claim: Formly offers unlimited responses with no restrictions
trials.claimQuote: Formly offers unlimited responses with no restrictions, allowing you to collect as many responses as needed.
trials.reasoning: The vendor qualifies unlimited use with fair usage, and its terms say a Fair Usage Policy applies to all users. That directly conflicts with unlimited responses with no restrictions.

exhibits.quote: No paywalls, no credit card, just generous fair usage so you can keep building with confidence.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited responses are qualified by generous fair usage, not no restrictions.

exhibits.quote: To ensure fair access to our platform’s resources, we have implemented a Fair Usage Policy that applies to all users.
exhibits.argument: All users are subject to a Fair Usage Policy that limits excessive usage.

exhibits.quote: With Formly, you can create unlimited forms and collect unlimited responses for free.
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own homepage promises unlimited forms and unlimited responses.

exhibits.quote: without the branding or having to worry about number of submissions or number of forms since I would use the form
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms not having to worry about number of submissions or forms.

trials.claim: Formly integrates with Google Sheets via Connect section
trials.claimQuote: To integrate Formly with Google Sheets, navigate to the 'Connect' section in your form's edit screen, select 'Google Sheets', and follow the prompts to link your Google account.
trials.reasoning: Multiple buyers confirm connecting Formly to Google Sheets and storing responses there. The prosecution exhibits do not deny that Sheets integration works.

exhibits.quote: Link Google Sheets with 3000+ apps and automation tools — no coding needed
exhibits.argument: Google Sheets is described as linking via apps and automation tools, not a native Connect section.

exhibits.quote: No support for webhooks (google sheets integration is NOT webhooks), poor styling options, no page-breaks so you only have a long form
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports Sheets integration is not real webhooks and is limited.

exhibits.quote: I can segment leads, ask better questions, connect everything to google sheets, and send people to the right next step automatically.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms connecting Formly data to Google Sheets works.

exhibits.quote: It's great that you can either store it to Google Sheets or something else, or you can just save it right within Formly itself.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Formly can store responses to Google Sheets.

trials.claim: Formly supports scores and calculations via Score Quiz and Calculator
trials.claimQuote: Yes, Formly allows you to add scores and perform calculations in your forms using the Score Quiz and Calculator features.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the Calculator cannot use form entries in calculations and does not work for most personality or best-solution quizzes. These specific limits materially undercut the claimed scores and calculations support.

exhibits.quote: The Calculator also isn't very advanced and you can't use form entries in the calculation, for example
exhibits.argument: Calculator cannot use form entries in calculations, undermining calculation support.

exhibits.quote: The only way to seperate answers is with a calculator, wich does not work for most personality or best solution quizzes.
exhibits.argument: Category scoring is impossible and calculator does not work for personality quizzes.

exhibits.quote: No brainer- super simple and the calculator forms are great!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the calculator forms feature works and is useful.

exhibits.quote: The ability to add a visual chart representing the score is going to have the exact impact I am looking for.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the score visualization feature works as promised.

trials.claim: Formly supports multiple question types including rating and opinion scale
trials.claimQuote: Formly supports various question types, including Multiple Choice, Two Choices, Dropdown, Image Choice, Rating, and Opinion Scale.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either way about rating, opinion scale, or the other listed question types.

themes.summary: Several buyers say support is fast, responsive, and solves problems via email or Zoom walkthroughs.

The support is fast and always solves your problem.

I received excellent support from Sha

themes.summary: Multiple buyers report custom domains breaking, publish errors, downtime, crashes, and severe lag.

Sometimes it's up and sometimes it's down.
I've been trying to weeks to get my forms to publish and I get errors
I had to add the domain back to my form even though it wasn't deleted.
it just has so much lag I have to wait for responses to populate before I can move on.

themes.summary: Buyers cite missing core capabilities like customization, keyboard navigation, answer summaries, and one-response limits.

hits.quote: There is very limited support for customisation - fonts and colours of text for example.
they continue to delay their release of keyboard navigation as an option
It doesn't give a summary of answers.
the ability to limit one response per user/device — a fundamental feature for maintaining survey integrity — is not currently available.

themes.summary: Many users say the tool delivers on its promise and reliably handles forms, logic, and embedding.

hits.quote: It does exactly what it promises to do.
having it embed on my website has been really seamless as well for different offers.
the tool has been working reliably and the layout is very easy to use
